name: Lumina Memory
description: User profile + long-term fact store + semantic recall (BM25 by default; mem0 via optional HTTP adapter). Phase 2.

profileDir.description: Override the directory for the user profile file. Defaults to ~/.lumina/profile/.

factStoreDir.description: Override the directory for the fact store JSONL. Defaults to ~/.lumina/memory/.

mem0BaseUrl.description: Optional HTTP URL to a mem0 service. If unset, the local BM25 recall is used.

mem0ApiKey.description: Optional bearer token for the mem0 service.

recallLimitDefault.description: Default number of facts returned by lumina_memory_recall when the caller does not specify.
